  - Day 9: 68.06 vs 66.37 = -1.69 (model overforecast by 1.69)
  - Day 10: 69.91 vs 68.18 = -1.73 (model overforecast by 1.73)

The error increases as we go further into the forecast horizon! This is a lag/compounding error.
